title: feat(fields,plugins,platform-objects): a select option is coloured only when its author declared a colour
body:
Fixes #36882
Fixes #37385
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #37406

## 维护者速读

- 所有应用的下拉选项：没登记颜色的标签（列表、分组行、看板、筛选面板、甘特图、日历）从按值自动上色变成中性灰；登记了颜色的照旧。平台自带对象（通知严重程度、审批状态、任务状态等）已在定义里登记了原来的颜色，看起来不变。
- 为什么做：HotCRM 维护者要求去掉系统默认配色，维护者裁定全部去掉、没配就灰，让标签颜色只表达作者登记的含义；服务端那半（平台自带对象自己登记颜色）在同一个 PR 里一起落地。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个本该有颜色的标签变灰，或甘特条变成默认蓝，数据不受影响；回退这个 PR 即可完全恢复原样。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

Ruling 7178358629 on #36882 (option A, the maintainer verbatim 「A 全部去掉，没配就灰」): a select option is coloured if and only if its author declared a colour.

- **`@object-ui/fields`** (term 1): `SEMANTIC_COLOR_MAP`, `BADGE_FALLBACK_PALETTE` and `hashToColor` are deleted. `getBadgeColorClasses(color)` answers the declared family or the neutral badge (`bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border`); `getSemanticColorName(color)` answers the declared family or `undefined`; the `appearance: 'dot'` branch answers the declared colour or `DOT_COLOR_MAP.gray`. Both helpers keep their second parameter (now `_value`, unread) so every caller compiles unchanged. Hex declarations (objectui#5141) are untouched.
- **Callers in the card's blast table** (grid cells and group rows, kanban, filter value panel) needed no code change: they all route through the two helpers. Docblocks that described the fallback are corrected (`ui/packages/types` `complex.ts`, `GroupRow.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`, and the shared `colorField` resolver `ui/packages/core/src/utils/record-color.ts`).
- **Gantt `colorField`** (term 2): rungs 1-2 stay (declared option colour, colour literal); rung 3 and the status / state / priority / severity fallback are gone, so an undeclared value leaves `color` undefined and `GanttView` paints its default bar colour. A palette family declared on an option (`color: 'blue'`) paints that family's palette hex through `getSemanticHex` (#3b82f6, the badge's blue), not the CSS named colour (#0000ff); only rung 1 can yield a family name, so no stored value is ever mapped.
- **Calendar** (term 1): the calendar's own 8-stop hash is deleted. `ObjectCalendar` hands `CalendarView` the declared option colour or a colour literal (the shared ladder), else only a value that already is a Tailwind colour utility (`isTailwindColorToken`); a category label or a palette family name stored as data hands on nothing. `resolveEventColor` keeps hex and Tailwind-utility pass-through, paints a palette family (which now only arrives as a declaration) with that family's tint, and paints `DEFAULT_EVENT_COLOR` for anything else.
- **No opt-in switch** (term 3).
- **Platform objects declare their colours** (term 6, #37385): every platform-shipped select option whose value hit the deleted table with no `color` of its own now declares the colour it rendered with (same family): 50 options on 27 fields. Enumerated at runtime: every object definition under `packages/**` (spec, cli, qa, lint, verify, tests and fixtures excluded; 176 files, 145 objects, 109 option-bearing fields) was imported and each option's value looked up in the table as it stood at the base commit; at this head the walk reports 0 table hits without a declared colour and every declared colour equal to the table's. `sys_notification.severity` and `inbox_message.severity` (info blue, warning yellow, critical red); `sys_approval_request.status` (pending yellow, approved green, rejected and cancelled red); and the status / state options of `sys_email`, `sys_identity_email`, `sys_import_job`, `sys_job_queue`, `sys_job_run`, `sys_job`, `sys_trusted_key`, `sys_task`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_audit_signing_key`, `sys_audience_binding_suggestion`, `sys_automation_run`, `sys_connector_credential`, `sys_flow_credential`, `sys_flow_dispatch`, `sys_sync_run`, `sys_channel_account`, `sys_notification_delivery`, `sys_notification_preference.digest`, `sys_notification_receipt`, `sys_file`, `sys_upload_session`, `sys_metadata.state`, and `sys_activity.type` `completed`. Array-shorthand entries became `{ label, value, color }` with the label the shorthand produces (`label` = the string, `value` = its snake case), so stored values and labels are unchanged (`check:i18n` in sync). `examples/**` are not declared: their undeclared options turning neutral is the ruled reach.
- **`@objectstack/spec`**: the calendar and gantt `colorField` descriptions named the retired derivation ("hashed from the value", "a semantic color token derived from the value"); they now name the default colour. Describe text only, restating ruling terms 1-2, no schema change (`check:authorable-surface` and `check:api-surface` unchanged); the references pages are regenerated.
- **Changesets**: two, one per card, both declaring `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: semantic` (an omitted option colour now means neutral: a changed default). `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/plugin-calendar`, `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` and `@objectstack/spec` are `minor`; the eight server packages `patch`. Spec is `minor` because Check Changeset judges the level only on the packages whose published source it counts as moved (spec and the server packages; the `@object-ui` packages are not among them), and the changed meaning of `colorField` is published from spec. The first names the reach, and that a declared colour outside the nine families renders neutral (#37435).

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`: `getBadgeColorClasses`, `getSemanticColorName`, the dot branch of `SelectCellRenderer`.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`: the bar colour block (`resolveColorFieldValue` is now the whole ladder).
3. `ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx`: `resolveEventColor` and `FAMILY_EVENT_COLORS`.

Two-minute verification: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/badge-severity-27521.test.ts`. Expect 4 passed: declared info / warning / critical are blue / yellow / red, and undeclared ones carry no palette family in light or dark.

## Tests

- **Rewritten to the declared path** (term 4): `badge-severity-27521.test.ts` (declared severity colours; undeclared neutral with no family class light or `dark:`; a control that the family pattern does match a declared family), and the no-colour cases of `badge-hex-fidelity-5141.test.tsx` (each now asserts the undeclared value neutral beside the same value with a declared family).
- **New pins, one per surface, neutral beside declared**: dot (`badge-hex-fidelity-5141.test.tsx`), grid group pill and desktop cell (`plugin-grid` `badgeHexCrossSurface.test.tsx`), kanban card (`plugin-kanban` `badgeHexCrossSurface.test.tsx`), filter value chips (`listConditions.test.tsx`), gantt ladder (`ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx`: no rung 3, no status fallback, a declared family paints its palette hex), calendar (`CalendarView.test.tsx`; `ObjectCalendar.colorFieldLadder-7243.test.tsx`: an undeclared value equal to a family name hands on nothing, a family declared on the option reaches the event, a Tailwind utility still passes). Light and dark: the neutral classes are theme tokens with no `dark:` variant, and every neutral pin asserts no palette-family utility, light or `dark:`.
- **Server half**: `sys-notification-display-labels.test.ts` asserts the declared severity colours; `approval-status-vocabulary.test.ts` asserts the declared approval status colours (and none on `recalled` / `returned`).


## Acceptance notes

- **Term 5, arm B.** The ruling's `minor` with `Metadata-protocol: none` cannot both pass the changeset gates; seat verdict 7182932149 (contract record 7182916794, M2) rules arm B, `Metadata-protocol: semantic` with fields, calendar and gantt at `minor`, and the zone amended both claim lines (7182960096).
- **Spec describe text** (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, outside the claim's file surface): prose only, the docs consequence of ruling term 2; no schema, export or authorable-key change.
- **Enumeration correction**: an earlier literal scan of `Field.select(...)` calls missed `sys_approval_request.status`, whose options are mapped from the contract's status list; the runtime walk above found it and it is declared in its own commit.
- **Gantt, a palette name stored as the value** (`accent: 'red'`): rung 3 used to map it to the palette hex; with rung 3 retired as ruled it now leaves the default bar. Hex, `rgb()` and `hsl()` values still pass through as rung 2.
- **Calendar, a family name**: declared on an option (`color: 'green'`) it paints that family's tint; stored as a record value with no option colour it paints the default event colour, as the gantt does.
- **Gantt, a declared family name**: paints the palette hex; before this PR it painted the palette hex through rung 3 as well, so a platform or app declaration of `blue` / `green` looks as it did.
- **A declared colour outside the nine families and not a hex** (`amber`, `teal`): the badge maps never knew these, so they used to reach the hash; they now render neutral, said in the changeset; the warning is carded as #37435. No platform or example option declares one; the kanban fixture that declared `amber` now declares `green`.
- **Values the hash alone coloured** (e.g. `recalled`, `returned`, `in_flight`, `timeout`) render neutral on platform objects too: term 6 covers the table, not the hash.
- Out of the ruling's scope and untouched: chart series colours (`buildOptionColorMap`), app-tile and presence avatar hashes, the gallery cover seed.

## Verification

Readings for heads `dc20242087` and the spec-level commit above it (objectstack, this branch, with `origin/main` 5d21d431ec merged). CI check-runs are cited in the report comment on #36882.

<details><summary>Rework round 1 (seat verdict 7182932149): what changed and its readings</summary>

- M2: both changesets declare `Metadata-protocol: semantic`; fields, plugin-calendar and plugin-gantt at `minor`. With spec left at `patch`, Check Changeset went red on head dc20242087 ("none of them is graded `minor` or above"; reproduced locally with the PR event, exit 1), so spec is `minor` too: `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main --event` exit 0 (LEVEL AXIS passes).
- S1, gantt: a declared family paints its palette hex. New pin in `ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx` (`blue` to #3b82f6, `green` to #22c55e). Ablation G (mapping removed): 1 failed, restored, blob equals HEAD.
- S2, calendar: an undeclared value equal to a family name hands on nothing. New pins in `ObjectCalendar.colorFieldLadder-7243.test.tsx`. Ablation H (raw value handed on again): 2 failed, restored, blob equals HEAD.
- The Tailwind-token check sits in its own module (`eventColorToken.ts`): 19 calendar tests mock `./CalendarView`, and a helper exported from it reached `ObjectCalendar` as undefined under those mocks (27 failed in the first run, 0 after the move).
- S3: changeset line naming out-of-family colours rendering neutral, and #37435.

</details>

<details><summary>Tests after the main merge (all exit 0)</summary>

- UI: plugin-calendar and fields together 397 files / 5550 tests passed; plugin-gantt 97 / 810. kanban, list and grid were not re-run locally (no change on either side since round 0, where they passed 88 / 582, 187 / 2071, 314 / 2792); Test UI covers them.
- UI type-check, `turbo run type-check` over fields, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-grid, plugin-kanban, plugin-list, core, types: 66 of 66 tasks, all eight type-check tasks cache misses.
- Server, packages the merge also touched: platform-objects 127 / 2176, plugin-security 290 / 7312 (including `insert-check-post-image.test.ts`); typecheck exit 0 for both. The other six server packages changed on neither side since round 0.
- Round-0 ablations A to F (badge, dot, calendar default, gantt rung 3, approval and notification colours) stand: those lines did not change.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 125 families for this diff, the same list as round 0; all were run on this round's heads with exit codes recorded. Three first refused as PREREQUISITE NOT MET in the fresh worktree (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`) and passed after a full packages build; the ui `scripts/` suite passed 172 files / 5130 tests; `check:type-check-debt` OK.

</details>
